text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
My fluttering heart is... beating so 
fast...! Giving you all my loveliness... 
doki-doki-kyun!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
My fluttering heart is beating fast. 
Giving you all my loveliness, 
kyun-kyun-kyun.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I heard that you had begun special 
training, but... this is...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Rhythmic contraction of muscles maintained 
at a steady tempo. Breathing exercises 
coordinated by vocalizations. And complete 
mental focus directed toward the active 
muscles.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore, raising body temperature 
through embarrassing cheer calls enhances 
metabolism, aiming to boost training 
efficiency.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I only asked for some advice on training 
methods... I never imagined it would turn 
into something like this...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, isn't that nice? If it's 
Ikuno-san's idea, we can certainly expect 
great results.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Y-You're right! All right, let's do this~!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, McQueen-san. Were you 
not looking for... an efficient way to 
burn fat?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Ah, yes, well, that's... I-I'm 
honored that you remember, but...!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Now, McQueen-san, please join in with me. 
Fluttering hearts, going pitter-pat. 
Sending lovely vibes, kyun kyun kyun.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Huh, l-lovely? Heart-throbbing? Ugh... I'm 
already blushing so hard...!
